# Flight Ops Calculators

Curated by Skill Harbor — ten quick offline calculators for flight planning and aviation students: crosswind components, descent planning, aircraft weight and balance, fuel requirements, climb performance, great-circle distance, holding patterns, V-speeds, fuel economy, and load factor — each returning the numbers with the assumptions it used, in clear units. It's a teaching and practice aid for understanding the calculations behind flight operations, not a dispatch tool: always verify its output against your aircraft's approved flight manual, approved performance data, and your operator's procedures, and get qualified instruction before relying on any calculation for a real flight. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @deepskyai. Honest caveats: Python scripts with real formulas — the math is legible, the judgment isn't; no account, no API keys, runs fully offline; weight-and-balance results in particular must be cross-checked against the aircraft's actual documents. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
